title: End-to-End Molecular Dynamics with a Langevin Thermostat on Quantum Circuits
summary: We construct a quantum-circuit framework for finite-temperature molecular dynamics in the canonical ensemble (NVT) with a Langevin thermostat, connecting canonical state preparation to subsequent physical-property readouts. The classical nuclear phase-space distribution is encoded as a Koopman--von Neumann (KvN) wave function, and canonical state preparation is formulated as Langevin-type Fokker--Planck relaxation.
